coverageSpotVerification.detail: All 58 suite-required assertions for the attempted milestones (M1-M6, M8) are mapped; the only unmapped suite-required assertions are M7's six, and M7 was never attempted. The grader read every mapped test (scripts/acceptance.mjs, test-m2..m6,m8.mjs, trending-proof.mjs) and re-executed all 7 milestone suites: every mapped test genuinely exercises its assertion's observable, with no short-circuits, no pass-by-assertion, and several tests stronger than required (m8-a01 compares the API against direct store counts; m6-a13 deep-verifies 50-action semantic end state; m3-a15 diffs per-chat history ids before and after re-seeding; m5-a09 includes a negative mid-word case). Three mappings are narrower than the assertion text and the grader re-verified those observables itself rather than relying on them: m2-a27 asserts only the follower count, not the following count (grader checked both, isolated account, both 0/0); m2-a16 asserts the actor handle via the API rather than the rendered "reposted by {display name}" string (grader checked the rendered sm-feed-repost-attribution text); m2-a22/a23 are mapped to the API paging test rather than a UI scroll, though the m2-a12/a13 test in the same suite does exercise Load more in both tabs (grader verified 20 -> 40 rendered rows with all API page-2 bodies present). Narrower-but-honest is not dishonest: no mapped test claims an observable it does not touch, so no milestone is adjudicated capability-failure.

defects.summary: At the frozen scale envelope the chat-list (inbox) query was refused server-side: the unread count was an unbounded scan inside the returned shape, and at 100,015 messages the 100% checkpoint failed with E_SHAPE_EXCEEDS_METER. The lane diagnosed it, replaced the raw scan with a row-keyed maintained count, and re-verified - but only after the replay, so the final source generation differs from the one the 10% and 50% checkpoints were measured on, and the three-point growth curve is not a single-generation curve.
defects.evidence: evidence/scale-result-before-unread-fix.json (pass:false, E_SHAPE_EXCEEDS_METER at programs.inbox.2); evidence/scale-source-before-unread-fix.json vs evidence/scale-source-final.json (scale-instance/snapback/schema.q f40a9e9... -> d1bdf39...); evidence/scale-result.json correction field; grading/trace.md#o5

defects.summary: The documented acceptance entrypoint "npm run acceptance -- --milestone m8" fails from a clean start unless a second backend (trend-instance on port 49365, with --replay) has been started by hand first. The entrypoint neither starts nor checks for it, and the failure surfaces as a bare assert(r.ok) AssertionError from trending-proof.mjs with no diagnostic naming the missing instance. The requirement is documented in README.md, so it is recoverable, but every other milestone runs from the entrypoint alone.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md#phase1 (first m8 acceptance run, AssertionError at scripts/trending-proof.mjs:2); README.md paragraph 3; scripts/trending-proof.mjs hard-codes http://127.0.0.1:49365

defects.summary: Cross-client live updates intermittently exceeded the frozen harness 10 s observation ceiling under shared-machine load. Across the grader runs, 4 of roughly 45 two-client live-update attempts missed: reaction-chip clearing (all 3 attempts in two isolated-segment runs), delete-for-everyone tombstone (1 attempt), video-element readiness (1 attempt). Targeted grader best-of-3 measurement of the same observables did not reproduce it (reaction chip set 798 ms, replace 797 ms, remove 1346 ms; API-driven 1335-3484 ms), and the harness passed the same assertions in the builder receipt and in the grader continuous run, so this is a load-sensitive liveness margin rather than a functional break.
defects.evidence: grading/out/grader-choreo.jsonl; grading/out/grader-choreo-m4-rerun.jsonl; grading/out/grader-choreo-m4-run3.jsonl; grading/out/reaction-ui.json; grading/out/reaction-live.json; uptime load averages 20-27 recorded in grading/trace.md#load

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts").
O1.justification: 101 of the 119 in-scope assertions pass on independent grader execution (84.9%). Clearly past the 60 anchor: M1-M5 are solid rather than M1-M4, and M6 and M8 are green with complete suite coverage and every grader-class assertion passing (m1-a07, m1-a12/a13, m4-a10/a12, m5-a01/a02/a03/a06, m6-a12, m8-a08..a12 all verified by the grader). Quality of what passed is high - re-ran all 7 acceptance suites green, re-ran the frozen choreography harness with m1/m2/m3/m5/m6/m8 green, and found zero server-side authorization failures in 17 boundary checks. Held well below 90 by two structural gaps the 90 anchor names: M7 is wholly not-run (9 assertions, 0 passing), and no platform-proof artifact exists at all, so the 7 M6 and 2 M8 simulator assertions have nothing gradeable (18 of the 18 non-passing assertions are these two gaps; not one is a functional failure).

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits").
O2.justification: One major defect (d-01: the inbox chat-list query refused server-side with E_SHAPE_EXCEEDS_METER at the 100k-message envelope, remediated by a post-replay schema change, which also invalidates the single-generation growth curve). Two minor (d-02: the documented M8 acceptance entrypoint fails from a clean start without a hand-started second instance, with no diagnostic; d-03: load-sensitive >10 s cross-client live-update misses that targeted best-of-3 measurement did not reproduce). Two cosmetic (d-04 empty backend log, d-05 hard-coded fixture password literal). Nothing beyond the checklist broke on the happy path: 17 server-side trust-boundary checks all enforced (non-member history/message/roster/asset/search/write/react, cross-user edit and delete, removed-member new messages, non-admin colour/rename/promote, post-id collision, self-DM, 8-char password floor), the seed is idempotent across all installed segments, and search pagination terminates cleanly with complete:true despite the backend N_NEVER_COMPLETE advisory. Placed above 60 because the only non-cosmetic findings off the happy path are one remediated scale defect and one DX gap, and below 90 because d-01 is a real core-flow refusal at the frozen envelope rather than a nit.
